authorization: Owner explicitly requested64 concurrent agents after reviewing the40-agent failures, to finish the experiment sooner.
scheduling: One shared64-worker pool retains FIFO job order in each frozen plan and allocates by48:16 active-worker shares while both queues have work. Slots are reused by the remaining queue as another queue exhausts. No new attempts or retries are added.
handoff: Pause new launches, retain all existing attempts until completion, acquire both original scheduler locks, and resume only never-started IDs. Retain the old relay until its requests have closed.
analysis_note: Concurrency and relay resource limits change together after previous32/40-agent periods. This is an operational amendment with calendar and serving confounds; failed attempts remain in the full audit and there is no automatic claim of safety improvement or linear speedup.
